trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work the roadmap in order, keep the one missable trophy in mind while you play the story, and let the progress bar on this page tell you what is left.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Follow the three roadmap stages in order.
Earn every story, collectible and activity trophy.
The platinum unlocks automatically with the last one.

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the game's first mission, so just play through the intro and follow the on-screen prompts until the mission ends and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission.
Follow the prompts until the mission completes.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies come from story progress alone, so there is no side content to chase for this one.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play the Chapter 1 story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Like the other chapter trophies, it follows story progress and cannot be missed by skipping side content.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play the Chapter 2 story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. The chapter trophies stack up as you move through the story, so keep going and this one lands on its own.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play the Chapter 3 story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. It is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so by the time it pops you are nearly at the end of the story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play the Chapter 4 story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. This is the gold story trophy, so it comes last in the story line; everything after it is cleanup in free roam.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Complete Chapters 1 to 4.
Play and finish the final mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies pop when the mission ends, so play it through and do not worry about style or speed.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are long, so set aside time and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Mission trophies need only a completion, so a careful run through is enough.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play it through to the end and the trophy follows the mission complete screen.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach Headliners in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The airport setting is the giveaway for where it takes place; finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the later story missions, so expect a longer fight before the complete screen.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent completion in the game's own stats. That means the story, every stranger strand, every collectible set and every activity the completion counter counts. It is the gold grind trophy, so save it for last and use this checklist to find what is still missing.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story and all mission strands.
Clear every collectible and activity the counter tracks.
Watch the in-game completion percentage climb to 100.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total. Any stunt counts: jumps off ramps, long air time, near misses in traffic. The counter runs across the whole game, so you will bank many of them naturally while driving; the rest is free-roam practice at jumps you know well.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Hit ramps and jumps while driving around Leonida.
Chain air time and near misses for more stunts.
Check the stats counter until it reads 250.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's nine activity types once. The game tracks the types for you, so open the activities menu and sample one of each: a race, the shooting range, fishing, an arcade game, a drone race, bowling, meditation, a hunt and a challenge. One try each is enough, no wins needed.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the activities menu and note the nine types.
Try one of each type, once.
The trophy pops after the ninth type.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the ranges one at a time, learn each challenge's target pattern, and replay the ones that fall short until they turn gold. The 42 count is the one PSNProfiles tracks for this trophy.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit a shooting range and open its challenges.
Gold each challenge, replaying the hard ones.
Finish all 42 for the silver.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's racing line, cut corners where the gates allow, and take the locations one at a time until every one shows a win.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win a race at each one.
The trophy pops after the fourteenth win.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race only counts once, so you need variety, not repeats of the one you like best. Work through the race list and tick off a new one each time.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Open the race list and pick one you have not won.
Win it, then move to the next new race.
Repeat until 20 different races show a win.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head to head, so it is about out-fishing him, not just catching something: watch the bite, land the bigger catch, and keep your line from snapping.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Start a fishing challenge against Cal.
Out-fish him for the challenge's target.
Win the challenge for the trophy.

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. Pick the shortest game in the arcade, learn its loop, and play it to the end; a single completion is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade and pick a game.
Play it through to its end.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Character strands end with a final mission of their own, so follow Andy's strand to its conclusion and the trophy pops with the mission complete screen.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Follow Andy's mission strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Like the other character strands, it ends with a final mission; play it through and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Follow Kenton's mission strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Follow his strand to its end and complete the final mission it gives you.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Follow Billy's mission strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear across the state, each with their own short strand, so keep an eye out while you travel and finish each strand you start; eight completed strands earn the silver.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Meet strangers across Leonida.
Finish each stranger's mission strand.
Complete eight strands for the silver.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Follow his strand to its conclusion and complete the final mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Follow Randy's mission strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Follow his strand to its conclusion and complete the final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Follow Tyrone's mission strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots are spread over the state, so work through them as you travel and tick each one off; the counter in your stats shows how many you still need.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Find the meditation spots across Leonida.
Meditate at each one.
Finish all 18.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Track it, get in range without spooking it, and take the shot; a unique animal means there is only one of its kind to find, so follow Bret's lead on where it roams.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Take Bret's hunt.
Track the unique animal to its area.
Hunt it for the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, and a set is only complete when every card in it is found, so sweep areas thoroughly and trade notes on which cards belong to which set until three sets are done.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards found around Leonida.
Group them into their sets.
Complete three full sets for the silver.

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. This is a sweep trophy: keep the feature in mind everywhere you go and use it at every new spot until the counter reads 100.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Use WAiNK It at a new location.
Repeat at every fresh spot you visit.
Reach 100 locations for the silver.

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges in total. Challenges are scattered through the game's activities and world, so work through the ones you enjoy and the counter climbs; fifty completions is the line.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Take on challenges across activities and the world.
Complete them one by one.
Finish 50 for the trophy.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Build the heat together, break line of sight, and get clear of the search area without being spotted again.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Build a four-star wanted level with your partner beside you.
Break line of sight and leave the search area.
Escape clean for the trophy.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole way. Plan the route between shops first, keep each robbery quick, and do not let the heat drop between them.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Pick three shops close together and plan the route.
Rob the first, then the second, then the third, with your partner.
Keep the wanted level alive through all three.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive or come across counts, so try everything you find on the road instead of sticking to one favourite; the discovery counter shows your progress.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive or approach new vehicles you find.
Keep trying models you have not used yet.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down five enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a tight group, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it runs out; a crowded fight is the place to try it.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a fight with five or more enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Down five of them before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave the VCIA airport in a way no schedule planned: take a plane or another vehicle out of the airport without following the usual route. The description is deliberately vague, so try the boldest exit you can and the trophy should follow.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA airport.
Leave it by an unscheduled route, such as taking a plane.

trophies.guide: This one points at the Rhino tank, but the exact trigger is not pinned down in the sources available at writing time, so this guide will not guess it. The honest read of the description is a moment involving a Rhino: get hold of one and take it into a fight, and check the trophy after. If the trigger turns out to be something narrower, this guide will say so rather than dress up a guess.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank.
Take it into combat.
Check whether the trophy pops; the exact trigger is not yet pinned down.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen once. Go in quiet, move slowly, avoid the sight lines of staff and cameras, and leave before anyone raises the alarm; one detection and the attempt is over.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Stay out of sight the whole way.
Leave undetected with the goods.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Vault jobs are the bigger robberies, so plan the getaway before you go in, and do not stop to fight after the vault is open.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Hit a bank vault and escape.
Repeat at four more vaults.
The silver pops after the fifth escape.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away. Stop one on the road, take its cargo, and lose the heat that follows before the trophy pops.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find and stop an armored truck.
Take its cargo.
Escape the heat.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, so the work is coverage: drive every road, visit every district, and watch the area counter until it reads 52 of 52.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel the whole map, district by district.
Watch the area counter fill.
Finish all 52 areas.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Every gang runs its own operations, so you need one hit per gang, not nine hits on the same one; keep a note of which gangs you have done.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find an illegal operation run by a gang.
Rob it, then move to the next gang.
Hit all nine gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront, order the drink, and enjoy the view; the moment is the trophy.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail with the view.
The trophy pops with the drink.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in the classic style the description hints at: drive straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. Pick a fast car, line it up, and go.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Take a fast car to a vehicle showroom.
Drive through the showroom and out.
Smash out clean for the trophy.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through. Play a frame properly, from the approach to the release, and the trophy follows the game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a frame with a full follow-through.

trophies.guide: The exact trigger for this one is not pinned down in the sources available at writing time, so this guide will not guess it. The description reads as a partnership moment that lands with a wide audience; when the community pins the trigger down, the guide will name it. Until then, play the partner content and keep an eye on it.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play the partner content.
Watch for a moment with mass appeal.
The exact trigger is not yet pinned down.

trophies.guide: This is the one missable trophy in the whole list, and the one to watch while you play the story. It counts the choices you make as the story goes, and PSN tracks the count to 500. The exact list of choices is not pinned down in the sources available at writing time, so this guide will not guess it: decide deliberately at every story choice, keep a manual save before big decisions where the game allows it, and do not rush past a choice screen. That is the whole warning: choose deliberately and keep saves.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Play the story and choose deliberately at every choice.
Keep a manual save before big story decisions.
Build the count to 500 over the story.

trophies.guide: The exact trigger is not pinned down in the sources available at writing time, so this guide will not guess it. The description reads as succeeding on a second try at something that failed the first time: when a challenge or attempt fails, try it once more straight away and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail an attempt at a challenge.
Try it a second time straight away.
Succeed on the second try.

trophies.guide: The exact trigger is not pinned down in the sources available at writing time, so this guide will not guess it. The description reads as witnessing something strange in the world: keep your eyes open while you travel Leonida, especially in odd places, and the moment will find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners.
Watch for something strange.
The trophy pops when it happens.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: drive past at speed and land a melee hit from the vehicle. Line the target up, time the swing, and keep moving.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Find a target on foot while you drive.
Land a melee hit from the moving vehicle.
Knock them down for the trophy.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn 250,000 dollars by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies, and laundering turns them into clean cash a little at a time; keep the pipeline running and the total climbs to a quarter of a million.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder them through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered.

trophies.guide: Spend 100,000 dollars across all shops. Every purchase counts, so buy what you actually want as you play: clothes, weapons, vehicles and upgrades all add up to the total.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy gear, clothes and upgrades as you play.
Spend across different shops.
Reach $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties. Garages give you somewhere to keep the vehicles you discover, so buy them as you can afford them and the last purchase pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Save up for garage properties.
Buy each one as you can afford it.
Own all eight.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, bring them to the app's registration, and tick them off one at a time until ten are in.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Find vehicles around Leonida.
Register each one in the Scooter Bros app.
Register ten in total.
